remarks: Welcome to 11582 Goetze Lane ideally located to offer breath taking views of Lake Ontario! This 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath year round property has been lovingly cared for and yes it even has a working telephone booth! From the moment you walk into this property you'll feel right at home.  The living room is bright, roomy and offers a beautiful view of Lake Ontario! The living room kitchen combo  is an open concept vibe and allows the chef to have full access to guests or family while cooking and entertaining. The phone booth is fully operational and doubles as a great conversation piece. The kitchen has lovely cabinets, plenty of work space,  a refrigerator which is almost brand new and there is plenty of room for a large dining table. Down the hall you'll find a large master bedroom with sliding glass doors which lead out on to the expansive deck running the full length of the upper living space and provides a place of serenity for reading or morning coffee while taking in the lovely lake views. Two nice sized  bedrooms are also located off the hallway and both offer ample storage and comfort. Upstairs there is a full bath with not only a jacuzzi tub but also a separate shower stall.  The newer washer and dryer are conveniently located behind decorative doors to hide and contain while keeping continuity of style. Egress stairs are located on the east and west sides of the home and provide easy access to the amazing 2 bay, 4 car garage with half bath space and ultimate man cave!  You can store vehicles, toys and still have space to store boxes and virtually anything your heart desires! This property is conveniently located for access to snowmobile trails, boat launches, restaurants and more including a 12.5 ft  Right of Way to the lake!  It is lake living at it's finest and this property won't disappoint! Delay of Negotiations to June 24, 2026 at 1:00 pm.
